BEHIND THE DRAWING

A compact model.
A measurable result.

SegFormer-B0, fine-tuned end to end on CubiCasa5K for 30 epochs. Five pixel classes become polygons, holes, bounding boxes, and opening spans.

Test-set segmentation

Intersection over Union

400 held-out plans · 94.71% pixel accuracy
Room instance F1: 38.87%. Room occupancy is stronger than room separation. These are Python evaluation results, not a benchmark of your browser.
